description: Swipe/drag from one point to another on the simulator screen. Coordinates are in simulator screen points. Use for scrolling, pulling down, or any drag gesture.

delta.description: Step size in pixels between each touch point (idb only, default: device decides)

durationMs.description: Swipe duration in milliseconds (default: 300). Use 400-600ms for edge-swipe-back

endX.description: End X in simulator screen points

endY.description: End Y in simulator screen points

startX.description: Start X in simulator screen points. Use 1 to trigger iOS left-edge-swipe-back gesture (iOS recognizes edge touches within ~20pt of edge)

startY.description: Start Y in simulator screen points

name: simulator_swipe
